# @sharadox/library-build-web-library

> One-command build for React component libraries: tsc → distribution/, *.module.scss → *.module.css, assets copied, style imports rewritten.

- Command: `library-build` (package.json "build": "library-build"), uses tsconfig.build.json.
- Copies: .css .scss .svg .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .avif .gif .ico .woff .woff2 .ttf .otf .json .glb .gltf; skips *unit-test.*, *benchmark-test.*, *end-to-end-test.*, test-fixture/, snapshot/.
- Sass load path: source/ (so `@use "style/token"` works).
- API: buildLibrary({ root, source, output, project, print }), buildPlan(files), rewriteStyleImports(code), listFiles(folder).
- License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
